fields.name: Shard key mapping
fields.definition: The provider attribute (`MapSqlShardKey`, `MapPgShardKey`; base `MapShardKeyAttribute`) that assembles a ShardKey property from mapped columns or parameters. It names the record-key columns (and child columns for compound keys), each of which must also carry its own mapping attribute with exactly the same name, and optionally a shard id column. Without a shard id column, the shard id comes from the connection that produced the row. With one, it comes from the data, which is how references to a foreign shard are read.
